**Conclusion: A.** Article 31(1) of the Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties requires interpretation in good faith, according to the ordinary meaning of the terms in their context and in light of the treaty's object and purpose. The shared note's options don't match this rule: C makes preparatory works the primary test, when Article 32 treats them only as a supplementary aid, and D drops the ordinary-meaning and good-faith elements.

CONFIDENCE: 95
